passage: Both sides in the dispute had hoped the committee would settle the matter. But the committee's report was deliberately ______: it described the problem in general terms while avoiding any recommendation that might upset either side.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical and precise word or phrase?
steps: The report avoided recommending anything and stayed general.
Refusing to take a position is being noncommittal.
"Decisive" is the opposite; "inflammatory" would upset people; "exhaustive" (very thorough) contradicts "general terms."
key: Test each choice against every detail in the explanation.
